arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
try:
    xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
    print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
    for name in xl.sheet_names:
        df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=name, header=None)
        print(f"\n--- Sheet: {name} ---")
        print(df.head(30).to_string())
except Exception as e:
    print("ERROR:", type(e).__name__, e)

import os, sys
from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"
print("PATH:", path)
print("EXISTS:", os.path.exists(path))
if not os.path.exists(path):
    print("XLSX_FILES_HERE:", [f for f in os.listdir(".") if f.lower().endswith((".xlsx", ".xlsm"))])
    sys.exit(2)

wbv = load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
wbf = load_workbook(path, data_only=False)
print("SHEETS:", wbv.sheetnames)
for name in wbv.sheetnames:
    wsv, wsf = wbv[name], wbf[name]
    print(f"--- sheet '{name}': rows={wsv.max_row}, cols={wsv.max_column}, dims={wsv.dimensions}")
    for r in range(1, wsv.max_row + 1):
        for c in range(1, wsv.max_column + 1):
            val = wsv.cell(row=r, column=c).value
            fml = wsf.cell(row=r, column=c).value
            if val is not None or (isinstance(fml, str) and fml.startswith("=")):
                coord = wsv.cell(row=r, column=c).coordinate
                extra = f" | formula={fml}" if (isinstance(fml, str) and fml.startswith("=")) else ""
                print(f"{name}!{coord} = {val!r}{extra}")

import sys
from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"
wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
ws = wb["Budget"]

items = []
total = 0.0
for r in range(11, 23):
    cat, name, amt = ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value, ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value, ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value
    if isinstance(amt, (int, float)):
        total += amt
        items.append((cat, name, amt))
    else:
        items.append((cat, name, amt))

for cat, name, amt in items:
    print(f"{cat} | {name} | {amt}")
print("TOTAL_EXPENSES:", total)
print("ROW_COUNT:", len(items))
